english:
Scoring 3 kills within 3 seconds with a Kinetic Weapon or a Weapon matching your Super's element creates an Elemental Pickup matching your equipped Super's element.

0.5 second cooldown after spawning a Pickup.

Collecting an Elemental Pickup grants <pve 5% /> <pvp [1%] /> Super Energy matching your Super's element.

2 second cooldown between additional Ability gains.

source.text:
Upon scoring 3 kills within 3 seconds of each using a Kinetic Weapon or a Super-Element Matching Weapon:

Creates an Elemental Pickup that matches the equipped Super Ability's element.
Incurs a 0.5 second cooldown upon spawning a Pickup.

Upon collecting an Elemental Pickup:
Grants 5% [1%] Element-Matching Super Ability.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown between additional Ability gains.
